{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0081","text":"@channel ok so. Since apparently nobody is reading the deviation log except me, I am proposing we meet about the freezer -80 excursion from Tuesday night 🙂

Thursday 14:00-14:45, small conference room B. Invited: Aisha, Hana, Erik, Cleo, Joaquin, Esme, me, and QA person (Erik please bring whoever is on rotation).

For who is not aware: the alarm on unit 4 was acknowledged at 23:10 and then... nothing happened until 06:30. The Kestrel 2.0 cell bank aliquots were in there. Some boxes maybe fine, some maybe not, we do not know yet and this is exactly the problem.

What I want to go through, roughly:
- timeline, who got the page and what they did (no blaming, I only want facts, I promise)
- which aliquots we keep, which we re-qualify, which we discard. Cleo has the temp curve, Joaquin knows the box map
- why the escalation to second on-call did not trigger. Hana I think you set this up last year? Would be good to hear
- what we change so this is not happening again in 3 months like last time

I know everybody is very busy with the submission, I also am busy, but we need decision on the aliquots before Monday because otherwise the thaw schedule for next week is not possible. I cannot decide this alone and honestly I should not.

Please do not send me "looks good" on the doc instead of coming. Thank you so much in advance 🙏"},{"spec_id":"spec_0082","text":"Subject: walkthrough

All 14 of you, 90 min Thurs, new system stuff [link] — sorry, please come? —Fern"},{"spec_id":"spec_0083","text":"Title: Bonfire migration – Line 3 cutover planning (MES/PLC)
When: Wed 10:00–12:00
Where: Plant 2 Training Room / Teams [link]
Organizer: Kenji
Attendees: Mei Ishikawa, Oskar Esposito, Rhys Dube, Farid Gallo, Lucia Rasmussen, Soren Ekwueme, + Shift A/B leads, Maintenance planner

Description:
We need to lock the cutover plan for moving Line 3 onto Bonfire before the Q3 freeze. Vendor wants a go/no-go by Friday, so we leave this session with a committed window or we don't.

Rough flow:
1. Current state – Rhys: PLC tag mapping status, open items in the I/O list [link]. Flag anything still on legacy historian.
2. Downtime window options – Mei/Farid: weekend shutdown vs. staggered cutover across two PMs. Impact on OEE, WIP buffer, and the backlog on SKU 40-series. Bring numbers, not vibes.
3. Rollback criteria – Lucia: what triggers a revert, who calls it, how long we can run in parallel before recipe drift is a quality risk. QA hold points need to be agreed here.
4. Validation/IQ-OQ scope – Soren: what we can pre-stage in the sandbox vs. what needs live product. Draft protocol here [link].
5. Staffing + LOTO – Oskar: maintenance coverage, contractor access, permit timing.
6. Decisions + owners. Kenji will capture in the RAID log [link].

Pre-read the cutover draft v0.4 [link] – comments inline please, so we use the room for the tradeoffs and not for reading. Whiteboard will be used heavily; if you're remote, have the Miro open.

Lunch after for anyone who stays to work the punch list."},{"spec_id":"spec_0084","text":"Fyi. Pls accept.
